tbesh_html:
A woman living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezk.23.4;
sister of: Oholibah (H0172)
§ Aholah = "her own tent"
Samaria as an adulteress with Assyria (metaph)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Oholah, a symbolic name for Samaria
strongs_1890.derivation: in form a feminine of H168 (אֹהֶל), but in fact for אׇהֳלָהּ; from H168 (אֹהֶל); her tent (i.e. idolatrous sanctuary);
